messages.subject: Is there duplicate storage of probe/chip effects
parts:
Sorry to bombard people's inbox -- just respond when it's convenient,
especially this one because it's not at all urgent, but just a
question for future reference. Probably a question for Ken...

With the exon arrays, you can choose the unit to either be transcript
cluster or probeset depending on mergeGroups=T/F. So my question is,
what if you want to run (and store for future use...) BOTH analyses.
Are they stored separately (in which case I don't understand what the
tags/directory structure would be). It seems like the two analyses
would just delete over each other if force=T or try to update each
other if force=F, which I don't know what would be the result.

Thanks,
Elizabeth
